summary: Complete testing of LowKey Lounge System. All 15 features verified working: Login, GET /api/lounges returns 8 regular lounges (LowKey Lounge, VIP Lounge, Kink Lounge, etc.), GET /api/lounges?afterDark=true returns After Dark lounge, GET /api/events returns 3 events, Home page shows 4 featured lounges with correct descriptions, lounge cards have unified structure (name, LIVE indicator, description, people count, Enter CTA), clicking lounge cards routes to /lounge?id=X (NOT /search), Events section shows 3 event cards, Quick Actions contains Radio/Games/Inbox, Lounge list page shows ALL lounges including After Dark with identical card structure.
seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded data - 9 lounges (LowKey Lounge 42, Night Owls 23, After Dark 31, Kink Lounge 18, Chill Vibes 15, Late Night Talks 12, Music Lovers 8, VIP Lounge 7, Music Corner 0), 3 events
context_for_next_testing_agent: Lounge system fully tested. All 4 named lounges exist with correct descriptions: LowKey='Where everyone starts. Real people, real energy.', After Dark='No names. No limits. Just energy.', Kink='Push boundaries. Find your people.', VIP='Private access. Elevated connections.'. Home page featured lounges section uses data-testid='active-lounges-section'. Lounge list page uses data-testid='lounge-list'. Cards have unified structure with LIVE indicator, description, people count, Enter CTA. Navigation routes correctly to /lounge?id=X (NOT /search). After Dark routes to /afterdark.
